description: On the tabletop in front of you there’s a blue sponge cloth and a small pump spray bottle, with the bottle’s clear cap lying off to the left. The left hand rests on and then lifts the left-hand object (the sponge cloth), shifting it slightly upward and left before pressing it back down and sliding it across the surface in short wiping strokes, while the right hand keeps the right-hand object (the spray bottle) upright nearby and adjusts its grip as if ready to spray.
